metric: Proposed extractions of repeated SELECTs into a shared model whose every consumer is proven unchanged (prover, or the copy is the shared SELECT after canonicalization); 450/450 families with equal copies get a verified refactor.
correctness: 0 refactors marked ready that change results when executed; a copy reading a CTE its model defines outside it is never ready
held_out: Seed 1, 3,000 models (tuned on): 714/749 ready, 0 unsafe; 450/450 families
caveats: Generated cases. Ready needs a proof: the prover, canonical identity, or merging the shared SELECT back into each copy. One extra-filter refactor still cannot be proven and stays not ready (it agrees when executed). Before this work every proposal was Not ready.
usefulness: 450/450 families with at least two equal copies have a verified refactor offered (3,000 models)
performance: 3,000 models: exact 18 s, near-duplicates 77 s, repeated work 8 s, refactor verification 64 s (600 models: 4 s, 6 s, 2 s, 14 s)
